architecture: One orchestrator, one page audit engine, one cache service, one bounded repair pass, one portfolio citation/backlink control plane, and one post-publish distribution observation chain.

severity_policy.hard_fail: Only corruption, unsafe publication, false evidence, wrong-domain routing, secret exposure, broken required journeys, nondeterministic governed output, or executable failure.
severity_policy.strong_warning: Repairable page defects, administrative drift, or a quality issue needing attention. Never blocks by itself.
severity_policy.soft_warning: Word-count targets, optional metadata, cadence variance, low cache hit rate, and editorial preferences.
severity_policy.self_repair: Generated daily pages receive one deterministic mechanical repair pass and one final audit. No recursive repair loops.

json.rationale: Malformed JSON is corruption; every downstream registry reads it.

workflow_trace.rationale: Workflow safety: a broken trace means release automation cannot be reasoned about.

pages_changed.rationale: Unsafe publication: page audit over changed output.

pages_release.rationale: Unsafe publication: page audit over release output.

pages_full.rationale: Unsafe publication: full page audit. Self-reports hard/strong/soft counts.

deterministic_build.rationale: Nondeterministic governed output, named verbatim in severity_policy.

hostile.rationale: Unsafe publication; already separates advisory fit notes from failures.

links.rationale: Broken required journeys and wrong-domain routing.

citation_contract.rationale: False evidence in the citation control plane.

portfolio_backlinks.rationale: Wrong-domain routing and affiliation-disclosure integrity across 476 published backlinks.

backlink_local.rationale: False evidence: verifies each published backlink actually resolves.

cache_self_test.rationale: Cache corruption would serve wrong bytes for governed output.

recovery_agency.rationale: Backfill and self-heal accounting is administrative drift; a gap is repairable and does not make published output wrong.

distribution_chain.rationale: Post-publish observation. Passes today with 0 verified citations, so it measures reach rather than correctness, and depends on secrets that are absent in local runs.

social_contract.rationale: Declares missing_secrets_nonblocking_by_default and strict_social_failure_opt_in - non-blocking by its own contract.

content_pattern.rationale: A page that carries no direct answer, no query-bearing h1, an empty table cell, or no outbound editorial link cannot be quoted by an answer engine or returns nothing when it is. All four checks measure 100% across the 495 published pages, so blocking cannot regress a clean surface.

published_tree_purity.why: sites/ is publicly fetchable and every AI crawler is allowed; an operator surface there discloses network operations regardless of its noindex meta.

analytics_separation.rationale: Wrong-domain routing: a placeholder, missing, shared or cross-publication analytics id sends one publication's reader data into another's project.

severity_matrix_policy.note: A validator absent from severity_matrix is treated as HARD_FAIL. Failing safe matters more than convenience: an unclassified check is one nobody has reasoned about.
severity_matrix_policy.strict_flag: --strict promotes STRONG_WARNING and SOFT_WARNING failures to blocking.
